why: The eFV feature frontier is closed (plan Part 2; the 2026-08-14 closure, 39 arms, zero survivors) and game power failed as an eFV driver four times (the Phase 1 partial, D-1 tool_game_pwr -0.0047, the C3 power pairs, iso_rel 0 of 11 folds; data/xfv_arm_ledger.json); nothing here re-runs a spent arm. The columns are NEW (a power composite chosen on realized ISO by a registered look, a tool-implied ISO residual, the inputs of an accuracy-weighted hit consensus) and exist on the owner's 2026-10-01 asks. The served eFV grade does not change.

owner_asks.message_1: Right now, we are only using raw power grade for our power tool composite grade and across the site. We have the data for "Game Power" tool on FanGraphs as well. Can we incorporate game power in some way and test to see if it corresponds as an eFV driver? Can we blend game power into our power composite grades to make them more accurate (and then test our power tool as an eFV driver)?
owner_asks.message_2: Similar to the way we do WAG, can we check each debuted player's statistical production against their tool-implied statistical production (using the FanGraphs framework, ex. power tool -> ISO, hit tool -> batting average, etc.) to see where different sources miss or hit more based on tools, and then accuracy-weight our tool grades accordingly? After doing so, if this proves to improve tool grade accuracy, can we then check if tool grades can be used as eFV drivers / how they should be weighted?

definition.per_source: each source's earliest snapshot inside the row's frame window [V-01-01, min(V-05-01, debut day)); non-rater and constant-anchor sources excluded as the frame excludes them
definition.consensus: unweighted mean across the outlets publishing the tool, rounded to 0.5
definition.pwr_comp: the as-of game_pwr and raw_pwr consensus inputs only; no a is stored or read (TL_16 cross-fits a per fold on board years up to V - 3, players outside the fold, only if a candidate)
definition.tip_iso_resid: iso_shrunk - tip; iso_shrunk = norm + w x (ISO - norm) on the frame block's level and season line, w = PA / (PA + 50), norm = the as-of level_norms avg_iso; tip = tool_implied.tip_level(table, game_pwr consensus, level, V, stat='iso', side='hit') with the table fit on MLB ISO pooled from the debut year to V - 1 (at least 300 PA) of frame players with a game_pwr consensus at a list vintage up to V - 1 who debuted before V, and league lines of seasons V - 5 to V - 1
definition.tool_hit_w: per-source hit grades only; the weight is BA2's estimator, computed per fold on players outside the fold's V frame, never stored as a value
definition.id: the frame row's outcome-blind mlbam_id (efv_identity, DS-03)
definition.missing: None, no entry when the row has no input at all; impute at the has-block TRAIN mean; no absence flag in any head (DS-04, bug B3)
definition.birth_date: the feed's printed season age placed at July 1 (level_norms age band only)
